one_job: Orient the listener to the exact phenomenon the thesis studies.
must_land: The unit is uncertainty in CEOs' unscripted Q&A answers. || The event is an acquisition that is not yet public, with cash deals as the focal setting. || The talk documents a descriptive language pattern rather than a causal mechanism.
cut_order: Name the research object: residual CEO Q&A uncertainty around undisclosed cash acquisitions. || Clarify that the question concerns a pre-announcement language trace. || State the descriptive, noncausal scope. || Speak the degree, institution, and adviser details already visible on screen.
next_slide_interface: End with the unresolved question of why an undisclosed deal could change answers; Slide 2 must supply the disclosure bind.

one_job: Make the listener understand the disclosure bind that creates the prediction.
must_land: The firm may hold material deal information while the routine earnings call still occurs. || The firm may remain silent, but anything it does say cannot mislead. || Hedged or qualified answers are a possible language trace while the deal remains private.
cut_order: Establish the private-information plus routine-Q&A bind. || State the core prediction: residual Q&A uncertainty may rise while the deal is private. || Preserve the boundary that the framework does not decide whether silence is constrained or strategic. || Explain the legal authorities or disclosure-theory citations individually.
next_slide_interface: End with the prediction being tied to the private-information state; Slide 3 must show when that state ends and why payment method supplies a comparison.

one_job: Set the two empirical contrasts: the information clock versus the transaction clock, and cash versus stock.
must_land: Announcement makes the information public, while completion is when cash leaves. || Cash and stock deals share the disclosure setting. || Stock deals add an equity-currency management incentive, which motivates comparison but does not identify a cause.
cut_order: Distinguish announcement from completion as two different clocks. || Explain that cash and stock share the disclosure bind. || State that the payment-method contrast is motivational and descriptive, not causal. || Elaborate the prior literature on equity-currency management or cash accumulation.
next_slide_interface: End by naming timing and payment method as testable dimensions; Slide 4 must convert them into the three research questions.

one_job: Give the listener a three-question map for the rest of the talk.
must_land: RQ1 asks whether residual uncertainty rises before cash-deal announcement. || RQ2 asks whether uncertainty changes at announcement while cash changes at completion. || RQ3 asks whether cash differs from stock using a direct difference test. || All tests are descriptive within-firm comparisons, not causal estimates.
cut_order: State the three questions in appearance, timing, and payment-method order. || Anchor all three in within-firm comparisons and the noncausal scope. || Flag that the cash-minus-stock difference is tested directly. || Read the equation-like labels or recite the full control list.
next_slide_interface: End by asking what is new about these three questions; Slide 5 must locate the missing literature cell before the empirical build begins.

one_job: Locate the thesis's narrow contribution relative to the nearest prior work.
must_land: Prior work reads managed tone, strategy vocabulary, or prices. || This thesis reads residual uncertainty in unscripted CEO Q&A before an unannounced acquisition. || The novelty claim remains qualified as 'to our knowledge'.
cut_order: Define the missing cell using the three contrasts: uncertainty, Q&A, and the anticipatory window. || Retain the 'to our knowledge' qualifier. || Name the three adjacent literatures at category level. || Describe each cited paper, author pair, and finding separately.
next_slide_interface: End with the exact empirical object now located; Slide 6 must show the data path capable of observing it.

one_job: Show where the evidence comes from and which firms it can represent.
must_land: The base panel contains 88,205 calls from 1,884 firms over 2002-2018. || Repeated calls and CEO identification are required to form the residual, narrowing the sample. || The focal first-cash-deal test contains 27,622 firm-quarters from 1,248 firms. || The sample tilts toward larger, better-covered U.S. public firms.
cut_order: Give the base panel, residual-feasible sample logic, and focal test sample. || State the deal screen: known payment split, at least $1 million, and at least 50% for an arm. || Disclose the larger-firm and better-covered selection boundary. || Recite every database and every intermediate count.
next_slide_interface: End with the sample narrowing because the outcome must be constructed; Slide 7 must explain that construction.

one_job: Make the residual measure understandable without implying that it directly observes what the CEO knows.
must_land: Raw uncertainty is the share of uncertainty words in CEO answers. || Predictable components, especially persistent CEO speaking style, are removed. || UncResCEO is the call-specific remainder, not raw uncertainty and not a direct measure of private knowledge. || It is a generated outcome, so two-step standard-error uncertainty remains a limitation.
cut_order: Explain raw word share minus predictable components equals the residual. || Emphasize removal of persistent CEO style and the call-specific interpretation. || State the generated-regressand limitation without attempting the full rebuttal. || List every first-stage control, sample statistic, and replication fit number.
next_slide_interface: End with the residual defined as the outcome carried forward; Slide 8 must show its first estimated pre-announcement shift.

one_job: Establish that the pre-announcement rise exists and communicate its size honestly.
must_land: The within-firm estimate is +0.0461 with two-tailed p=0.0074. || The estimate is about 15.3% of the residual's usual across-call standard deviation. || The rise is modest but statistically clear and descriptive, not causal. || The displayed interval is approximately derived from the estimate and standard error, not printed by the thesis.
cut_order: State the direction, estimate, and descriptive comparison. || Translate magnitude as about 15% of the usual residual spread. || Give one uncertainty indicator: p-value or approximate interval, without narrating both at length. || Recite the full control list, sample counts, standard error, and both interval endpoints.
next_slide_interface: End with existence established but timing unresolved; Slide 9 must trace the measure through announcement and completion.

one_job: Show that language and cash move on different clocks around the same deal.
must_land: PRE2 shows no statistically detected elevation; this is a check, not proof of no pre-trend. || Residual uncertainty rises at PRE1 and becomes indistinguishable from baseline at GAP; the PRE1-minus-GAP Wald drop is significant. || Cash shows no detected PRE1-to-GAP decline and declines after completion. || Cash persistence means absence of a detected decline, not a significantly elevated GAP level. || Both paths use the same matched firm-quarters and remain descriptive.
cut_order: Explain the two clocks through the adjacent-stage contrasts. || Preserve the cash-persistence caveat and the noncausal scope. || Define the baseline and bins only as much as needed to read the figure. || Walk every point estimate, standard error, p-value, lag coefficient, and sample count.
next_slide_interface: End with timing established but payment-method concentration still untested; Slide 10 must perform the direct cash-versus-stock comparison.

one_job: Distinguish a descriptive side-by-side pattern from the formal direct cash-minus-stock test.
must_land: The side-by-side panels show a cash run-up and an imprecise stock estimate, but separate significance is not the test. || The pooled Wald difference is +0.0983 with two-tailed p=.039. || The evidence supports concentration in cash, not a cash-only effect or a mechanism. || The result is supportive but fragile because the stock estimate is imprecisely negative.
cut_order: Lead with the direct pooled difference and its interpretation. || State why separate stars cannot establish a difference. || Preserve the concentration-not-specificity and fragility caveats. || Walk the PRE2, GAP, and POST coefficients in both descriptive panels or recite all sample details.
next_slide_interface: End with the three findings now complete and bounded; Slide 11 must state what those findings add rather than repeat them.

one_job: State the thesis's three descriptive contributions without re-selling the results.
must_land: It places residual CEO Q&A uncertainty in the anticipatory window before disclosure. || It tests cash against stock directly rather than comparing separate significance results. || It links private-information withholding research with transaction-anticipation evidence through the private-to-public passage. || The contributions characterize a regularity and identify no causal channel.
cut_order: Name the anticipatory window, formal contrast, and literature bridge. || Keep the descriptive, noncausal ceiling explicit. || Use one clause to distinguish the thesis from prior tone, vocabulary, and price work. || Recount coefficients or restate all three result slides.
next_slide_interface: End by defining the contribution as deliberately descriptive; Slide 12 must specify the evidence boundary that follows from that choice.

one_job: Set the exact boundary between the observed language pattern and claims the design cannot support.
must_land: The study identifies a within-firm language pattern, not cause and effect. || The sample's size and coverage limit generalizability. || Announcement dates do not reveal when negotiations began. || The word-list measure and stock comparison are imperfect instruments.
cut_order: State the noncausal boundary first. || Retain the timing, sample, and measurement boundaries in compressed form. || Clarify that uncertainty words do not directly reveal private knowledge. || Repeat detailed sample dates, S&P approximation, or full descriptions already covered on Slides 6 and 7.
next_slide_interface: End with what survives all four limits: a bounded, readable within-firm pattern; Slide 13 must close on only that durable claim.

one_job: Leave the committee with one precise, bounded take-away.
must_land: Unscripted CEO Q&A carries a readable anticipatory trace as a deal moves from private to public. || The signal is observed before announcement and is no longer distinguishable from baseline at announcement. || The run-up is stronger in cash than stock, stated as concentration and not strict specificity.
cut_order: Deliver the private-to-public take-away. || Retain the stronger-in-cash qualification and descriptive language. || Use the disclosure clock as the closing structure. || Repeat exact coefficients, re-list limitations, or narrate the visible thank-you text.
next_slide_interface: No next slide: stop after the bounded take-away and hand the room to questions without adding a new claim.
